release.0.6.0.title: Scene edit history preview
release.0.6.0.history: Undo and redo tile strokes and entity edits. A continuous brush stroke is one step.
release.0.6.0.render: Resolution and background color edits have their own steps in the same history.
runtime.read-only: Runtime view. Stop to edit the scene.
runtime.input-hint: Click the viewport to send keyboard input to scripts.
runtime.script-hint: Press Enter to apply. Clear the field to detach the script.
runtime.script-invalid: Use scripts/<name>.lua with letters, digits, underscores or hyphens in the name.
release.0.5.0.title: Scene runtime and Lua scripts
release.0.5.0.runtime: Play and Stop run an isolated copy of the edited scene.
release.0.5.0.scripts: Entities can run Lua scripts that read keyboard input and update their position.
diag.cli: Use tools/scene_cli.py for validated AI scene edits.
diag.save-conflict: Save refused because the scene changed on disk. Local edits are still in memory.
inspector.preview: The sprite viewport uses XY positions.
inspector.select: Select an entity in Scene Hierarchy
language.zh-unavailable: Chinese language pack or font unavailable
lua.failed: Lua reload failed. Preview uses the last valid result or scene settings.
lua.ready: Lua preview ready. Save the script to reload.
name: Name
release.0.1.0.languages: Switch between English and Simplified Chinese. Untranslated entries fall back to English.
release.0.1.0.lua: Reload Lua preview scripts on save and retain the last valid background color after an error.
release.0.1.0.scene: Inspect and edit scene entities, save JSON scenes, and make validated edits with the scene CLI.
release.0.1.0.title: First Windows build
release.0.1.0.windows: Launch the Windows x64 editor with a dockable interface and an example scene.
release.0.1.1.history: Open the release history to see the features delivered in each version, in English or Simplified Chinese.
release.0.1.1.identity: See the running version in the title and toolbar. Copy it from the history panel or query it with --version.
release.0.1.1.title: Version and release history
release.0.2.0.title: First GPU sprite viewport
release.0.2.0.viewport: Edit sprite and camera XY positions in a D3D12 viewport. The scene resolution controls the pixel target, displayed with nearest sampling.
release.0.2.0.save: Refuse stale scene saves and ask before reloading a scene with unsaved edits.
release.0.3.0.title: Sprite assets and viewport selection
release.0.3.0.import: Import a transparent PNG into the scene's asset folder and attach it to a sprite. Save and reopen to restore the image.
release.0.3.0.pick: Click a sprite in the viewport to select the frontmost sprite under the cursor and outline its bounds.
release.0.4.0.title: Tilemap brushes
release.0.4.0.brush: Paint continuous strokes of floor or wall tiles in the viewport, or erase individual cells.
release.0.4.0.scene: Tiles render behind sprites and are saved in the scene. Select mode retains sprite picking.
release.0.4.1.title: Tile brush drag fix
release.0.4.1.drag: Dragging inside the canvas paints tiles. Drag the title bar to move the viewport panel.
reload.unsaved: Reloading will discard the current unsaved edits.
render.roadmap: Pixel target limits: 1 to 4096 per axis.
sprite.asset-error: Sprite image unavailable. Showing the built-in image.
sprite.selection-changed: The original sprite is no longer available in this scene.
window.title: PRE - Pixel Rendering Engine
